subject: West Ham storm back from 3-0 down at Cardiff in Parker's first game
title: Parker's first game: 3-3 at Cardiff

lines.vo: Three-nil down at half-time. Three-all at full time.
Scott Parker had been West Ham boss for one day.
lines.footage: Scott Parker first game West Ham reaction

lines.vo: Cardiff's Jack Moylan scored a hat-trick before the thirty-ninth minute. Three goals, no win. Harsh.
lines.footage: Jack Moylan hat-trick Cardiff West Ham

lines.vo: Then Parker made his half-time changes. Divine Mukasa pulled one back.
lines.footage: Divine Mukasa goal Cardiff West Ham

lines.vo: Arne Engels scored his first West Ham goal. Max Kilman headed in a Bowen cross.
Relegated last season, West Ham now sit eighth. That is the final play-off place.
Scott Parker is unbeaten as West Ham boss. Sample size: one game.
